_documented_capabilities: Retrieve a full list of companies linked to your account
Add a company to your account
Remove a company no longer in use

_why: Inform Direct describes the Integration API as adding/removing companies
and retrieving HIGH-LEVEL company details. Officers, shareholders and
filing history are not part of that description, so the SA close-company
check cannot move off the browser yet. If a later version adds them, move
the entries below into 'operations' and they start working - the code for
them is already written and tested.

list_companies.description: Every company linked to the account.

add_company.description: Link a company to the account.

remove_company.description: Unlink a company no longer in use.
